Text: Crushed underfoot. They didn't even notice.
One careless step. That's all it took.
You were in the wrong place at the wrong foot.
The cat was just playing. You were not.
To it, you were a toy. Game over.
The cat was bored. You paid the price.
The driver didn't even brake.
The queen will not be pleased.
The bag is packed. The door is locked. Game over.
Avocado. Fruit stall. Don't get a bruised one.
Eggs. From the mart. Don't get cracked ones.
...Oh, and mushrooms too. Same mart. Go.
Daddy!! Can we have pizza tonight?? PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE!!
Ice cream. You know which one. Don't get the wrong kind.
Oh! The ice cream Mom likes — it's from the guy in the PINK HAT at the shop!!
Alright... time to head home.
...Oh wait.
...She always loved those flowers. Maybe it'll calm her down.
Where did you sleep last night?? ...You know what, fine.
Since you're already out there, you better pick some things up on the way home
I'm sending you the list.
Still not here?? It's packed out there — watch those feet and hurry up.
You said 5 minutes. That was 45 minutes ago.
Hello?? Did you get stepped on or something??
I'm not mad. I'm DONE. Get. Home. Now.
...I'm packing a bag.
